SoFi members products growth guidance 2026 2027 demand outlook
SoFi Technologies market share personal loan OR pricing trend 2026

findings.claim: Q3 2026 Lending 調整後淨營收約 $807.4M，年增 68%，由個人貸款需求與較高發放費用驅動
findings.excerpt: The company's lending segment generated $807.4 million in adjusted net revenue, up 68% year over year, driven by strong demand for personal loans and higher origination fees.

findings.claim: Q3 2026 Financial Services 淨營收 $525.1M 年增 25%；淨利息收入年增 38%、非利息收入年增 13%
findings.excerpt: For the third quarter of 2026, Financial Services segment net revenue of $525.1 million increased 25% from the prior year period.

findings.claim: Q3 2026 Technology Platform 營收年減 24% 至 $87.4M（大客戶 2025 年完成遷出）；排除該影響年增 18%
findings.excerpt: Technology Platform segment revenue declined 24% year over year to $87.4 million, reflecting the departure of a large client that completed its transition off the platform in 2025. Excluding that impact, segment revenue increased 18% from a year earlier.
The 2027 outlook represents approximately 27% adjusted net revenue growth and a net income margin of approximately 20%.

findings.claim: Q3 會員 17.1M（+35%）、產品 26.7M（+44%）；管理層稱未見會員借貸/消費/儲蓄/投資放緩
findings.excerpt: We are not seeing evidence of a slowdown in how many members borrow, spend… save, or invest.

findings.claim: Lending 佔調整後淨營收 59%（去年同期 51%），收入結構向貸款集中；TD Cowen 分析師質疑個人貸款高速成長可持續性
findings.excerpt: Lending made up 59% of adjusted net revenue in the third quarter, up from 51% a year earlier.

findings.claim: Dolphin Research 估計 SoFi 個人貸款市佔由 2023 年約 6.8% 升至 2025 年底約 12%（LPB 驅動）；Truist 另有 >25% 估計，口徑不同、日期不明

end_markets.note: 未找到個人貸款定價（APR）趨勢的獨立來源；Credit Services TAM 共識未查到。市佔 as_of 為推估。
